title: [performance] Report to live counts only the landings the live record can see, the Scorecard names where its window's measuring starts, and the Core lines card says "measuring since" until the 7 days are covered
prompt:
Read crates/spawn-cli/src/scorecard/history.rs (`live`: each landing's report to the first ok `deploy.finished` at or after it; the `deploy.finished` arm), scorecard/measure.rs (`counts`, `report_to_live`, `Window`), crates/spawn-postgres/src/scorecard.rs (the facts query: control records over the whole log), serve.rs's core-lines module (objective 084, with 086's performance line) and web/src/coreLines.ts (`coreLinesView`).

This comes after objectives 081 (report to live, live), 084 (the Core lines frame) and 086 (its performance line). 084 and 086 must be in the tree.

The problem (lead-mac, 2026-11-12 15:30). The Scorecard's 7-day report to live reads 107 h, an artefact. `deploy.finished` records began on 11-12. Every landing from before then counts as going live with the first deploy recorded, so the 7-day median measures when the record began, not the wait. Today alone reads 94 min. The Core lines card (086) shows the 7-day figure as the performance north star, so the owner reads 107 h as the fleet's speed.

Required behaviour.
(a) The Scorecard's report_to_live, in every scope and window:
- The live record begins at the first `deploy.finished` record of any outcome, read over the whole log (not only the window), as the facts query reads it.
- A landing counts only if it landed at or after that start. An earlier landing is neither live nor not_live: it is in no part of report_to_live (its other dimensions, lead time and first pass among them, are unchanged).
- The dimension's parts gain `measured_from_ms`, the later of the window's start and the record's start (null with no deploy record, when no landing counts), and `covered`: true when the record starts at or before the window's start.
(b) The Core lines performance north star `performance.report_to_live`:
- While its window (the Scorecard's default 7 days, as 086 reads it) is not covered, the figure has no value (null, so `not_collected`) and carries `measuring_since_ms`, the window's measured_from_ms. Once covered, it is the Scorecard's value as 086 says, with no `measuring_since_ms`.
- web/src/coreLines.ts says "measuring since <MM-DD HH:MM>" (local time, two-digit fields) for a figure with `measuring_since_ms` in place of "not collected yet". The module keeps loading with node alone.
- The Home card shows it like any figure. Read off a screenshot.
No gate, integrator or deploy step reads any of it.

Acceptance: rsi/scenarios/095.sh. The history is 081's: five landings, deploys ok at -9 h, -6 h and -4 h, a failed one at -7 h. The first deploy record is at -9 h, and task 1 lands just before it (-9.5 h). One more task (6) reports at -31 h and lands at -30 h. Under 081's rule there are six landings, five live: median 1.0 h, p90 22 h. Under this objective tasks 1 and 6 are before the record. Checks:
- (1) `/api/scorecard`: fleet report_to_live is median 1.0 h, p90 2.0 h, n 3, not_live 1, measured_from_ms the record's start, covered false. `/api/scorecard?since=8h`: covered true, n 3, not_live 1, measured_from_ms the window's own start.
- (2) `/api/core-lines`: the performance north star is null, `not_collected`, with measuring_since_ms the record's start. Under node (TZ=Asia/Shanghai), coreLinesView says "measuring since <MM-DD HH:MM>" for it, and "1 h 30 min" for the same figure covered with 5,400,000 ms.
It fails with 1 on 47348208, the live tree: n is 5 and p90 22 h, with no measured_from_ms or covered, and /api/core-lines answers 404. Its throwaway stacks 084's and 086's throwaways on 47348208 (sync/obj-095/throwaway.diff).

The same series amends the two scenarios that seed 081's history, so they hold under both rules:
- 081.sh (c9a8dc33) and 086.sh (ae208f23) each seed a deploy that failed 8 days ago. Under this rule their record therefore begins before the window, and every landing counts as before. A failed deploy ships nothing, so their figures are unchanged under 081's rule.

Expected on live after the deploy (not a defect): the record began on 11-12, so until about 11-19 the card says "measuring since 11-12 …" in place of the 7-day figure. The Scorecard's 7-day figure falls from 107 h to the record's own landings, near today's 94 min. Report to live keeps no range until then.

The product reason. The performance north star is the figure the owner steers machine time and money by. A 107 h reading that is really "the record began on Tuesday" is worse than no figure. This makes the figure count only what was measured, and makes the card say when the measuring began. Monitoring only.

Rules: never edit the protected paths, which the gate rejects: rsi/, scripts/ (scripts/rsi/, scripts/blackbox/, scripts/e2e.sh among them), deploy/, all of web/ except web/src/, web/test/ and web/index.html, rust-toolchain files and .cargo/. The gate also rejects fewer runnable tests than the base, any lint relaxation and any build-time code. The gate builds offline from the cargo caches already on the host. Keep every existing check green (081, 084, 086, 061, 065 and 067 among them) and add tests of your own for the new behaviour:
- a scorecard unit test of the record's start: a landing before the first deploy record (counted in neither part), the first record a failed deploy, no deploy record at all, a window starting before and after the record;
- a spawn-postgres test, through the real store, that the record's start is found when the first deploy record is older than the window;
- a core-lines unit test of the north star covered and not covered;
- a web/test case of the "measuring since" words.
